title: Verifier Claim Registry - v2
description: Composable S1 universal verification claims. Consumers resolve the pinned v1 base registry first, then these additions. This artifact defines claims; it does not declare implementation support in any verifier build.

claims.name: permit.type.v1
claims.assertion: The signed Permit decision carries exactly one admitted semantic identity whose selector and fact-profile contracts resolve under the versions and digests pinned by the evidence pack.
claims.required_evidence: Supported permit.decision.v1; signed resource attributes; semantic binding; pinned semantic selector registry; and, for exact actions, the pinned fact-profile registry and facts schema.

claims.name: permit.exact_target.v1
claims.assertion: Every target fact required by the pinned fact profile is present, schema-valid, and covered by the signed Permit decision resource-attribute commitment.
claims.required_evidence: Supported permit.decision.v1; supported permit.type.v1; fact-profile target_fact_paths; exact authorization facts; pinned facts schema; and signed resource-attribute commitment.
does_not_establish: external identity behind an unopened commitment

claims.name: permit.material_request.v1
claims.assertion: Every material request fact required by the pinned fact profile is present, schema-valid, signed, and matches the recorded exact dispatch request digest when dispatch evidence is supplied.
claims.required_evidence: Supported permit.decision.v1; supported permit.type.v1; fact-profile material_request_fact_paths; exact authorization facts; and exact dispatch request digest when dispatch is claimed.

claims.name: permit.valid_at_dispatch.v1
claims.assertion: The recorded pre-effect dispatch instant is on or after Permit issuance and strictly before the signed effective expiry boundary.
claims.required_evidence: Supported permit.decision.v1 with issued_at and expires_at; signed runtime enforcement proof or scope-faithful dispatch-boundary evidence; and a trusted dispatch instant.

claims.name: permit.revocation_at_dispatch.v1
claims.assertion: No effective Permit revocation preceded the recorded pre-effect dispatch instant within the declared scope-faithful evidence boundary.
claims.required_evidence: Supported permit.decision.v1; trusted dispatch instant; signed Permit revocation evidence; scope-faithful lifecycle population through a checkpoint boundary; and pinned revocation temporal semantics.

claims.name: permit.enforced_at_certified_boundary.v1
claims.assertion: The exact request crossed a pre-effect gate whose adapter certification and customer deployment assurance were active, unexpired, unrevoked, and applicable to the signed Permit consequence at dispatch.
claims.required_evidence: Supported permit.decision.v1, permit.type.v1, and permit.material_request.v1; signed adapter certification; signed deployment assurance; signed runtime enforcement proof; certification and deployment revocation evidence; trusted signing keys; and matching project, surface, adapter version, request digest, consequence, and dispatch instant.
does_not_establish: absence of all external bypass routes beyond the certified deployment scope

claims.name: permit.bounded_use.v1
claims.assertion: A signed monotonic use transition consumed exactly one use for the exact dispatch without exceeding the signed Permit maximum-use limit.
claims.required_evidence: Supported permit.decision.v1 with maximum-use limit; signed permit_bounded_use.v1 transition; exact request digest; dispatch id; idempotency-key commitment; previous counter state or scope-faithful counter history; and trusted signing key.
does_not_establish: single use unless maximum_uses equals one
absence of uses outside the declared scope

claims.name: permit.single_use.v1
claims.assertion: The signed Permit maximum-use limit equals one and the scope-faithful bounded-use history contains exactly one valid transition for the Permit.
claims.required_evidence: Supported permit.bounded_use.v1; signed maximum_uses=1; and scope-faithful bounded-use population through the declared checkpoint boundary.
does_not_establish: absence of activity outside the declared scope

claims.name: permit.replay_prevented.v1
claims.assertion: No second dispatch with the same Permit and exact request identity was accepted by the certified boundary within the declared scope-faithful dispatch population.
claims.required_evidence: Supported permit.enforced_at_certified_boundary.v1; signed exact request digest; bounded-use or dispatch identity; and scope-faithful dispatch population through the declared checkpoint boundary.
does_not_establish: absence of activity outside the certified boundary
absence of activity outside the declared scope

claims.name: permit.idempotency_bound.v1
claims.assertion: The committed idempotency identity is bound to one Permit, one exact request digest, and the recorded dispatch or bounded-use transition.
claims.required_evidence: Supported permit.material_request.v1; signed idempotency-key commitment; Permit id; exact request digest; dispatch id; and signed runtime enforcement or bounded-use evidence.
does_not_establish: provider-side idempotency unless provider evidence establishes it

claims.name: provider.receipt_state.v1
claims.assertion: A provider receipt is schema-valid, bound to the same Permit, dispatch, operation, provider, and exact request digest, and follows the pinned provider-receipt state machine.
claims.required_evidence: Supported permit.material_request.v1; provider_receipt.v1 artifact; pinned provider receipt-state semantics; prior receipt when a transition is asserted; evidence digest; and source classification.
does_not_establish: independent truth of a provider assertion
external real-world outcome without independently verified evidence

claims.name: provider.rejected.v1
claims.assertion: Authoritative provider or transport evidence establishes that the exact dispatch attempt was rejected before provider acceptance.
claims.required_evidence: Supported provider.receipt_state.v1 for the same Permit and dispatch with state=rejected; source-specific rejection semantics; and no contradictory later receipt in the scope-faithful receipt chain.
does_not_establish: absence of a separate dispatch attempt

claims.name: provider.accepted.v1
claims.assertion: Authoritative provider evidence establishes that the provider accepted the exact dispatch attempt.
claims.required_evidence: Supported provider.receipt_state.v1 for the same Permit and dispatch with an acceptance-establishing state and source class; exact request binding; and source-specific acceptance semantics.

claims.name: provider.completed.v1
claims.assertion: Authoritative provider evidence reports that the exact dispatch reached the provider's defined completed state.
claims.required_evidence: Supported provider.receipt_state.v1 for the same Permit and dispatch with state=completed; exact request binding; and source-specific completion semantics.
does_not_establish: independent truth of a provider assertion
external real-world outcome without independently verified evidence
